transport: Codex app-server stdio, ephemeral task, no native environment tools, only a wrapper-owned dynamic container-exec tool
candidateBoundary: Unprivileged constrained disposable container; only adapter writable; evidence read-only; internal network to immutable fixture; no host/home/credentials/evaluation mounts
tokenAccounting: Count reported input (including cached input once within total input) plus output; no automatic retries; stop at the first received usage report meeting threshold
residualExposure: The in-flight server response can exceed 60,000 aggregate tokens before usage is reported or cancellation propagates. No maximum token overrun or dollar cap is guaranteed.
activationRequires: Explicit human approval replacing strict token ceiling for these two runs
